WidgetFlow

Live widgets laid out as a DAG, in the style of FormulaDAG. The quickest way in is WidgetFlow.from_widgets([...]): pass the widgets, and the arrows come from marimo's own dataflow graph while every widget is captioned with its variable name.

data.text/markdown: Pass edges to WidgetFlow yourself to pick the arrows. An edge's third item is a label, or a dict with label, color, dashed, and exit/enter sides. layers pushes a widget further down: here degree sits next to the data it is fitted to instead of at the top.
